title: Store listing: fastlane metadata and screenshots
findings_note: no fastlane directory; no screenshots or listing text exist
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the privacy policy and developer docs (S20), submitting to F-Droid or Google Play (owner actions), and a feature graphic.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: F-Droid reads listing text and images straight from the repository's `fastlane/metadata/android/` tree, and Google Play can consume the same layout. Neither can be submitted without it.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None. A small shell check validates lengths (see Check).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `title.txt`: `Consecutor`.
2. `short_description.txt`: one line of at most 80 characters, for example "Private habit and measurement tracker with streaks. No accounts, no cloud."
3. `full_description.txt`: under 4000 characters. Cover tracker types, streaks derived from editable history, local reminders, CSV and JSON export, and that there are no accounts, ads or analytics. Do not claim features that are not in the app.
4. `changelogs/<versionCode>.txt` for the current `versionCode`: under 500 characters.
5. `images/icon.png`: 512 by 512 px, exported from S12's artwork.
6. Screenshots: on an emulator, seed demo data with four trackers (Water: COUNT daily 8; Meditate: YES_NO daily; Run: COUNT weekly 3; Weight: MEASURE) and about 30 days of entries (create a demo backup JSON in the scratchpad and import it; do not commit it). Capture the dashboard, a detail screen with chart and calendar, the tracker editor and settings, in light and dark mode, with `adb exec-out screencap -p > N.png`. Only the data you created is visible.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `wc -m` confirms: short description at most 80 characters, full description under 4000, changelog under 500.
- Images are the correct size and no personal data is visible in them.
